title: Canva Education premium tools at no cost
description: Verified K–12 educators can access Canva Education, including premium design tools, classroom templates, collaboration features, and LMS integrations.
eligibility: Verified K–12 teachers and eligible schools; school information or educator documentation may be required.

title: Office 365 Education A1
description: Eligible educators can use web versions of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneNote, Outlook, and other Office 365 Education services.
eligibility: Educators and students with an eligible education email address at a qualified organization.

title: Free Headspace access for educators
description: Educators can receive meditation, sleep, breathing, focus, and stress-management content through Headspace's educator program.
eligibility: U.S. K–12 public, private, and charter teachers, school staff, and administrators; age requirements apply.

title: Educator Library Card with extended borrowing
description: Borrow up to 100 classroom items for 42 days, place up to 25 holds, and avoid late fines. Cards renew annually.
eligibility: Public, private, charter, and homeschool educators serving qualifying Fort Worth schools; educator documentation is required.

title: One free exhibit admission for Pre-K–12 educators
organization: Fort Worth Museum of Science and History
description: The museum lists one complimentary exhibit admission for qualifying educators. Special events and blackout periods may have separate rules.
eligibility: Pre-K–12 educators with a valid educator ID; confirm current exclusions before visiting.

title: Teacher discount on eligible purchases
description: Verified teachers can receive an additional discount on eligible regular-price and sale items in stores and online through Michaels Rewards.
eligibility: Teachers who complete educator verification in Michaels Rewards; product and daily-use exclusions apply.

title: Renewable Educator Discount Card
description: The renewable Educator Discount Card provides year-round savings on in-store purchases at Half Price Books.
eligibility: Qualifying teachers, teaching assistants, school or city librarians, and eligible homeschool educators with current verification.

title: Creative Cloud Pro education pricing
description: Adobe offers discounted Creative Cloud Pro access to more than 20 creative apps, with different introductory and renewal pricing.
eligibility: Eligible students and teachers; school-issued email or other verification may be required. Review annual-plan terms and renewal price.

title: Education pricing on eligible Apple products
description: Apple's Education Store provides special pricing on eligible Mac, iPad, accessories, services, and coverage options.
eligibility: K–12 employees, homeschool teachers, eligible higher-education students and staff, and certain school or parent purchasers under Apple's terms.

title: Education Offer Program
description: Verified educators can access private Samsung pricing on eligible phones, tablets, computers, displays, appliances, and accessories.
eligibility: Current teachers, educators, students, and faculty who verify with a qualifying school email or ID.me; limits and exclusions apply.

title: Teacher and educator member discount
description: Dell offers verified teachers an education discount on eligible computers and electronics through its member purchase program.
eligibility: K–12 teachers and post-secondary faculty who join Dell Rewards and complete status verification; eligible products only.

title: Extra educator savings after verification
description: Teachers and eligible students can verify their status in the cart to receive additional savings on qualifying Lenovo products.
eligibility: Educators and eligible college or university students who verify through ID.me; select products may be excluded.

title: Teacher savings on eligible wireless plans
description: AT&T's teacher program provides plan-specific savings on eligible unlimited wireless service for qualifying educators and their account lines.
eligibility: Certified or licensed K–12 teachers and eligible college or university faculty who complete proof-of-eligibility verification.

title: Monthly teacher discount on eligible mobile plans
description: Eligible teachers can register for monthly discounts on selected Verizon mobile plans. The amount depends on the plan and number of lines.
eligibility: Qualifying teachers with an eligible Verizon mobile plan who register and verify their status; excluded plans apply.

title: GitHub Education benefits for teachers
description: Verified teachers can access education tools and resources including GitHub Team, GitHub Classroom support, and GitHub Copilot Pro benefits.
eligibility: Currently employed educators at qualifying educational institutions with a school-issued email and proof of academic employment.
